goal: Prevent logging deadlocks when consumer callbacks trigger logging during garbage collection or finalization
Restrict kernel logging to one connection handle to match the process-wide singleton reality
agreement: Concept support because single connections are simpler and pragmatic for consumers (sedited)
Answered objection: premature API restriction is hard to reverse and lacks benefit (ryanofsky)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it fixes potential deadlocks at the kernel boundary when consumer callbacks invoke logging
It eliminates thread serialization on user callbacks and aligns the public API with singleton behavior
